jobs.title: Director of Software Engineering
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

If you are a software engineering leader ready to take the reins and drive impact, we've got an opportunity just for you.  

  

As a Director of Software Engineering at JPMorganChase within the Consumer and Community Banking Team, you lead a technical area and drive impact within teams, technologies, and projects across departments. Utilize your in\-depth knowledge of software, applications, technical processes, and product management to drive multiple complex projects and initiatives, while serving as a primary decision maker for your teams and be a driver of innovation and solution delivery.  

  

**Job responsibilities**

* Engage with business stakeholders to break down complex and ambiguous problems into technical specifications that an engineering team can implement under your guidance.
* Deliver and own end\-to\-end cutting\-edge low latency solutions leveraging the latest technologies and the best industry practices
* Champion engineering practices; Improve the effectiveness of the Engineering teams through coaching, mentoring and resolution of impediments
* Partner with leadership team for driving Non Functional Requirements, Modernization initiatives and controls
* Sets direction and governance for agentic AI\-enabled engineering and SDLC/TLM automation within a technical area to drive measurable improvements in speed, quality, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI\-orchestrated delivery workflows, release readiness controls, automated test modernization, and incident triage acceleration), while establishing guardrails for validation, security, resiliency, traceability, and reuse across teams.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation and support capacity unlock initiatives at scale.
* Lead and participate in regular technical meetings, ensuring that architectural decisions align with the broader organizational goals and strategy.
* Partner with product and business groups, to drive participation, plans, timelines, dependencies and solutions to ensure successful delivery leading to desired outcomes
* Drive the adoption of AWS cloud technologies, enablement tools and processes for our engineering teams, as a part of integration
* Create and maintain detailed technology roadmaps with corresponding work streams and stakeholders, ensuring all solutions and requirements are clearly understood and communicated
* Carries governance accountability for coding decisions, control obligations, and measures of success such as cost of ownership, maintainability, and portfolio operations




**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 10\+ years applied experience. In addition, 5\+ years of experience leading technologists to manage, anticipate and solve complex technical items within your domain of expertise.
* Extensive hands\-on experience in designing and building full stack cloud native distributed systems with high degree of availability, fault\-tolerance \& scalability using Java Spring.
* Experience in handling large volume of data with Databases like PostgreSQL, Oracle is critical for the role.
* Curious and comfortable with exploring new domains with the ability to consider both the technology \& product angle
* Ability to deal with direction changing quickly, and ability to learn and establish patterns quickly
* Understanding and experience with cloud technologies, software engineering/product engineering methods, technology best practices.
* Experience leading adoption of agentic AI\-enabled engineering practices (using enterprise\-authorized tools within the work environment) across teams, including defining operating expectations (human\-in\-the\-loop validation, quality gates), measuring outcomes, and ensuring secure handling of sensitive inputs/outputs.
* Strong understanding of responsible AI use and control expectations in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity, resiliency/security implications, and governance; ability to influence leaders on safe scaling patterns and reuse.
* Understand and convey programming models, technologies, systems and API's that are relevant for stakeholders
* Work with product teams regularly to ensure understanding and alignment of requirements and technical solutions




**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Participate and/or lead opportunities with third parties, working to understand why and how we may integrate and leverage their capabilities
* Knowledge of Lending and/OR Buy now pay later space.
* Experience with hiring top talent, growing careers and coaching individuals and managers to higher performance


**ABOUT US**

jobs.description:

Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

	+ Define technical standards and best practices for cloud\-native development, microservices, and event\-driven architectures

	+ Architect and implement intelligent solutions using AzureAI, AI Builder, and Azure Cognitive Services to deliver persona\-driven experiences
	+ Design and optimize data pipelines and analytics platforms using Azure Synapse and COSMOS DB

* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* 6\+ years of professional experience in software development, with at least 2\+ years in a senior or lead role
* Technical Expertise
	+ Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation using Azure DevOps
	+ Experience with AccelQ or similar test automation platforms
	+ Solid proficiency in Python, C\#, JavaScript, and .NET Core for full\-stack development
	+ Deep understanding of Azure ecosystem including Azure Synapse, Azure Service Bus, AzureAI, and COSMOS DB
	+ Solid grasp of DevOps and DevSecOps principles, with hands\-on experience implementing secure and scalable solutions
	+ Advanced knowledge of SQL for data modeling, querying, and performance tuning
	+ Familiarity with AI Builder and persona\-driven AI development
	+ Proficient in using GitHub Copilot for AI\-assisted coding and productivity enhancement
* Architecture \& Design
	+ Experience in building distributed systems and integrating event\-driven components using Azure Service Bus
	+ Proven ability to design and implement microservices\-based architectures and cloud\-native applications
	+ Leadership \& Collaboration
	+ Demonstrated experience mentoring junior engineers and leading technical initiatives
	+ Demonstrated solid collaboration skills with cross\-functional teams including product, QA, data science, and DevOps
	+ Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions
* Soft Skills
	+ Excellent problem\-solving and analytical thinking
	+ Solid communication and interpersonal skills
	+ Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
	+ Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with emerging technologies

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI\-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!


Title  

Senior Software Engineer \- Kubernetes Agents and Services\- P3  

  

Description  

**Your opportunity**  

  

At New Relic, we provide our customers real\-time insights, so they can innovate faster. Our software delivers insightful observability tools across different technologies and distributed systems, enabling software engineering teams to identify, understand and tackle issues, analyze performance, and maximize their software and infrastructure.  

  

The Infrastructure Instrumentation organization is looking for a Software Engineer to join our group in US. This organization develops and maintains instrumentation agents and integrations for a wide range of products, including Kafka, MySQL, etc... In this role you will work on Kubernetes integration that gives our customers full observability into the health and performance of their K8s environment, backend services that powers these dashboards and queries as well as on the user interfaces which are critical to design and implement dashboards.  

  

We encourage async communication and independence, but we also build strong human relationships between team members during our ceremonies..  

  

**What you'll do**  


* Build, maintain, and scale Go/Python clients/projects and their support tools.
* Contribute to Open Source and get the chance to grow your reputation and skills.
* Collaborate with team members to discuss and implement service improvements, research new tools and services to solve sophisticated problems properly.
* Ship incrementally and often, helping the team to maintain a constant flow of feedback on its work.
* Work in an agile environment with a DevOps approach—teams build and maintain their own software, including participating in second layer support rotations.

  

  

  

**This role requires**  


* You have experience and are passionate about instrumentation, agents, large scale distributed systems, Linux systems, software architectures and Go programming language.
* Strong Golang/Python experience and familiarity with scaling applications in Kubernetes environments
* Willingness to work on UI components to display queried data gathered from multiple backend services.
* You're an autonomous, cross\-functional, and agile person who thrives in a fast\-paced environment focused on delivering high\-quality software at a regular cadence.
* You're self\-motivated, learn fast, accountable and demonstrate creative problem\-solving skills.
* You thrive collaborating with colleagues in important decisions and sharing code ownership.

**Bonus points if you have**
* Experience developing instrumentation products, helm charts.
* Experience developing on different Unix OSes and Windows.
* Upstream contributions to relevant Open Source projects (e.g. OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, DBs, http servers, etc

Fostering a diverse, welcoming and inclusive environment is important to us. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day. We celebrate our talented Relics’ different backgrounds and abilities, and recognize the different paths they took to reach us – including nontraditional ones. Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We’re looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes.



If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruiting process, please reach out to resume@newrelic.com.



We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success through a flexible workforce model. This model allows us to work in a variety of workplaces that best support our success, including fully office\-based, fully remote, or hybrid.


**Our hiring process**  

  

In compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work and to complete employment eligibility verification. Note: Our stewardship of the data of thousands of customers means that a criminal background check is required to join New Relic.  

  

We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records based on individual circumstances and in accordance with applicable law including, but not limited to, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.  

  

Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. New Relic does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes, and will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with New Relic.



New Relic develops and distributes encryption software and technology that complies with U.S. export controls and licensing requirements. Certain New Relic roles require candidates to pass an export compliance assessment as a condition of employment in any global location. If relevant, we will provide more information later in the application process.



Candidates are evaluated based on qualifications, regardless of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, age, disability, neurodiversity, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Specialist Manager, Analytics and Insights - Talent Experience & Engagement - Hyderabad
jobs.description:
Your role will focus on translating talent data into actionable insights that support strategic decisions, workforce planning, and talent operations. As a **Specialist Manager, Analytics and Insights**, you will partner with Talent leaders and cross\-functional stakeholders to design data\-driven solutions, shape reporting strategy, and deliver executive\-ready insights. This role is ideal for a professional who combines analytics, stakeholder management, and storytelling to help drive informed decision\-making across the talent lifecycle.


**Work you'll do**


As a **Specialist Manager, Analytics and Insights** on the People Analytics team, you will be responsible for:


* Partnering with stakeholders across the talent lifecycle to design data solutions that support business decisions and talent operations
* Developing executive\-ready analytics, dashboards, visualizations, and presentations using tools such as PowerPoint, Tableau, and One Model
* Leading strategic reporting and analytics initiatives, including roadmap development, project coordination, and cross\-team delivery
* Supporting complex analyses and high\-priority data requests from senior leaders to enable informed decision\-making
* Managing junior team members while advising Talent leaders on opportunities identified through workforce data and insights

**The team**


The People Analytics team collaborates across Talent and the business to uncover data\-driven insights to solve business challenges across the talent lifecycle and enable transformational change inside of Deloitte. Our teams (e.g., data science, surveys, candidate assessments, evaluation, sensing) provide a holistic and client\-centric approach that complements our wide range of analytical tools and methods to identify valuable workforce insights which, in turn, fuels the business.


This role engages directly with Talent leadership/teams to deliver on requests across products and services People Analytics offers. Client Solutions professionals are expected to act as data advisors, developing strong, concise points of view for leadership to support informed decision\-making.


We’re looking for a versatile professional to be a key player in our journey to deliver holistic data driven insights to our Talent leaders and teams.


**Location: Hyderabad**


**Shift Timings: 2 PM to 11 PM**


**Qualifications**


Required:


* Bachelor’s degree
* 10\+ years of experience in project management, reporting, analytics, and data visualization
* Experience with data transformation or data modeling tools such as Tableau Prep or Structured Query Language (SQL)
* Experience creating executive\-ready presentations, dashboards, and analytics deliverables
* Experience using Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Teams in a business environment
* Experience aggregating and analyzing operational data to identify insights and trends
* Experience managing team members and coordinating deliverables across multiple stakeholders

Preferred:


* Graduate degree

**Our purpose**  


Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
**Our people and culture**  


Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
**Professional development**  


At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.
**Benefits to help you thrive**  


At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
**Recruiting tips**  


From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

You enjoy shaping the future of product innovation as a core leader, driving value for customers, guiding successful launches, and exceeding expectations. Join our dynamic team and make a meaningful impact by delivering high\-quality products that resonate with clients.

  

  

As a Product Manager within the Consumer and Community Banking team, you will leverage your expertise in product development and optimization to make a significant impact. You'll use user research and customer feedback to fuel the creation of innovative products and enhance existing offerings. With a strong focus on scalability, resiliency, and stability, you'll collaborate with cross\-functional teams and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our products and the ongoing success of our organization.

  

  

**Job responsibilities**


* Partners with the Product Owner to identify new product opportunities that reflect the needs of our customers and the market through user research and discovery.
* Considers and plans for upstream and downstream implications of new product features on the overall product experience.
* Supports the collection of user research, journey mapping, and market analysis to inform the strategic product roadmap and provide insight on potential product features that provide value to customers.
* Analyzes, tracks, and evaluates product metrics including work to time, cost, and quality targets across the product development life cycle.
* Writes the requirements, epics, and user stories to support product development.
* Supports the completion of change management activities across functional partners and monitors adherence to the firm's risk, controls, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
* Raise blockers and other impediments to the Product Manager and assist in driving solutions to removed blockers.
* Assist Product Owner in managing timelines and reporting risks and issues.
* Remain flexible in a changing environment due to high demands from products across the firm all working to solution their highest priority change.
* Excel in communication, collaboration, and coordination across product and technology to ensure the needs of our customers are clearly understood and we expeditiously deliver solutions that meet or exceed their needs and expectations.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**


* 5\+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in product management or a relevant domain area
* Proficient knowledge of the product development life cycle
* Experience in product life cycle activities including discovery and requirements definition.
* Developing knowledge of data analytics
* Demonstrated performance in either product management or relevant domain area.
* Experience executing operational management and change readiness activities.
* Experience in product deployment processes
* Understand the process and practice of Agile software delivery.
* Support Product Manager with breaking down a complex problem into manageable and achievable parts, then the experience to see it thru to implementation.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**


* Demonstrated prior experience working in a highly matrixed, complex organization
* Firm knowledge of the product development life cycle
* Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively collaborate with stakeholders, present findings, and document requirements.
* Teamwork and Collaboration: Ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and engineers.
* Strong diligence to ensure accuracy and precision in data analysis, documentation, and requirement gathering.

**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  

  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**  

  

  

Our Consumer \& Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most\-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.  

  

We are here to help you manage your money with checking, savings and credit cards, combining the latest banking technology with comprehensive solutions to meet the financial needs of nearly half of U.S. households.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Senior Software Engineer**
============================


**What will I be getting myself into?**
---------------------------------------


As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help shape the future of our Horizon platform and the way we build software. Horizon is the platform behind SkySpecs' wind and solar inspection and asset\-management business, and the work is hands\-on building, end to end.


As the cost of producing code falls, an engineer's impact comes more than ever from judgment, design, and outcomes, not volume. AI is central to how we work here, and we treat it as serious leverage: a force multiplier for engineers who already have strong instincts, not a substitute for them. We expect everyone to keep pushing what AI, automation, and agents make possible, and to bring the judgment that makes that leverage pay off.


We do not separate thinking from doing. Engineers are expected to understand the problems they are solving, formulate effective solutions, and participate directly in delivery by writing and owning production code. The people closest to the work are expected to challenge assumptions, improve proposed approaches, and actively shape how outcomes are achieved.


This is a full\-stack engineering role. While engineers may develop areas of deeper expertise, we expect everyone to be capable of working across frontend, backend, infrastructure, data, and developer tooling as needed to deliver outcomes. We value engineers who can understand the entire system, formulate end\-to\-end solutions, and contribute wherever the work requires.


Our platform is built using AWS, GitLab, Auth0, Grafana, Terraform, Kafka, Node.js, TypeScript, Apollo GraphQL, React, Ant Design, Vitest, Playwright, and PostgreSQL.


**IN A GIVEN WEEK, YOU WILL:**


* **\[15%]** Work with product managers, customers, internal users, and other engineers to understand requirements, constraints, and desired outcomes.
* **\[10%]** Formulate solutions, evaluate tradeoffs, and break work into executable milestones and implementation plans.
* **\[55%]** Build and ship software. Examples include:
	+ Authoring and infrastructure as code.
	+ Designing and implementing new services and APIs.
	+ Building reusable user experiences and workflows.
	+ Improving reliability, performance, security, and developer productivity.
	+ Reviewing code generated by peers and by agents
	+ Leveraging AI tools and autonomous agents to accelerate delivery.
* **\[20%]** Improve Horizon, our engineering systems, and the way we work. Examples include:
	+ Building internal tooling and automation.
	+ Improving documentation and architectural clarity.
	+ Reducing operational toil.
	+ Expanding AI and agent capabilities.
	+ Improving testing, observability, and deployment workflows.
	+ Exploring new ideas, experiments, and prototypes that could improve Horizon or the way we build software.

Success is measured by outcomes delivered, not lines of code written.


**Requirements**
----------------


### **Core Expectations**


* 5\+ years in roles where you wrote, shipped, and operated production software.
* Depth in at least one part of the stack and the range to work across the rest.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals and systems\-thinking.
* Ability to independently drive work from requirements through delivery.
* Good judgment around tradeoffs, architecture, and maintainability.
* Strong written communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work within a cross\-functional team of technical and non\-technical contributors.
* Ability to work effectively across multiple layers of the stack.
* Experience working with AI\-assisted and agentic development workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted and agentic development workflows, and a track record of evolving how you use them.
* Sound judgment when using AI tools, including reviewing and correcting agent\-generated code.

### **Bonus Points for**


* Familiarity with our stack: AWS, GitLab, Auth0, Grafana, Terraform, Kafka, Node.js, TypeScript, Apollo GraphQL, React, Ant Design, Vitest, Playwright, and PostgreSQL.
* Experience building internal platforms, developer tooling, or automation systems.
* Experience operating distributed systems at scale.
* Background in utility scale energy generation, emphasis on renewables

**What We Value**
-----------------


* Own outcomes, not assignments.
* Have strong opinions that are loosely held.
* Operate autonomously and are self\-accountable.
* Create clarity from ambiguity.
* Improve systems, not just features.
* Take initiative in identifying and addressing risks, improvements, and opportunities that increase the impact of their work.
* Continuously learn, adapt, and experiment with new technologies and ways of working.


**Location \& Logistics**
-------------------------


This role works out of our Hyderabad, India office with hybrid flexibility. Applicants will be expected to attend team meetings that overlap with the US Eastern timezone.


**Relocation:** This position does not offer financial support for relocation.


**Sponsorship:** We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time.


**Compensation:** Base salary dependent on experience and location. Position is eligible for discretionary annual bonus.

  

*SkySpecs is an equal opportunity employer. SkySpecs does not discriminate in employment with regard to race, color, religion, national origin, citizenship status, ancestry, age, sex (including sexual harassment), sexual orientation, marital status, physical or mental disability, military status or unfavorable discharge from military service or any other characteristic protected by law.*

 We are looking for a dynamic Manager, Product Management to be part of the Clinical Intelligence product area within the Cohere platform and manage a team of Product Analysts, with full accountability from strategy to execution. Ultimately, your work will directly impact the growth and evolution of the Clinical Intelligence that powers all of our products. Reporting locally to the VP, General Manager India, this is a critical role that provides an uncommon opportunity to build new products and capabilities and to scale and evolve existing ones.
   

  

 You should apply if you are a leader with a product mindset who delivers value to the business by inspiring teams to build and market solutions that
 *really* 
 work for users and elegantly solve complex problems. You’ll sit in the center of strategy, design, engineering and operations to drive multiple levels of decisions, from what “north star” metric we should drive towards, to signing off on acceptance criteria on a new feature. You understand the market and the competitive landscape of AI in healthtech and are able to quickly synthesize, develop hypotheses, provide team direction and prioritize requirements for your products.

* Conducts customer and market research, user feedback, usage, and competitive analysis to identify unmet market needs and complex new product applications
* Oversee the end\-to\-end product development process, making strategic decisions and solving complex challenges.


**Required Qualifications**
**Must\-haves**
* 5\+ years of experience in Product Management including at least 2 years managing people
* 3\+ years working in healthcare and/or HealthTech
* Demonstrated expertise in ML/AI applications to healthcare problems
* Strong interpersonal, presentation, and communication skills
* Product mindset with a proven ability to deliver customer centric solutions
* A successful track record of co\-creating seamless experiences in collaboration with stakeholders from customer facing and technology functions spread across the globe


**Nice\-to\-haves**

**Ability To Commute/relocate**

**Interview Process\*:**

**About Cohere Health**
 Cohere Health’s clinical intelligence platform delivers AI\-powered solutions that streamline access to quality care by improving payer\-provider collaboration, cost containment, and healthcare economics. Cohere Health works with over 660,000 providers and handles over 12 million prior authorization requests annually. Its responsible AI auto\-approves up to 90% of requests for millions of health plan members.
   

  

 With the acquisition of ZignaAI, we’ve further enhanced our platform by launching our Payment Integrity Suite, anchored by Cohere Validate™, an AI\-driven clinical and coding validation solution that operates in near real\-time. By unifying pre\-service authorization data with post\-service claims validation, we’re creating a transparent healthcare ecosystem that reduces waste, improves payer\-provider collaboration and patient outcomes, and ensures providers are paid promptly and accurately.
   

  

 Cohere Health’s innovations continue to receive industry wide recognition. We’ve been named to the 2025 Inc. 5000 list and in the Gartner® Hype Cycle™ for U.S. Healthcare Payers (2022\-2025\), and ranked as a Top 5 LinkedIn™ Startup for 2023 \& 2024\. Backed by leading investors such as Deerfield Management, Define Ventures, Flare Capital Partners, Longitude Capital, and Polaris Partners, Cohere Health drives more transparent, streamlined healthcare processes, helping patients receive faster, more appropriate care and higher\-quality outcomes.
   

  

 The Coherenauts, as we call ourselves, who succeed here are empathetic teammates who are candid, kind, caring, and embody our core values and principles. **Job Description**
**Job Description and Responsibilities**
 We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Launch Manager to lead strategic product launches across our Generics and Consumer Health portfolio.

* Ensuring achievement of business objectives, evaluating the business case/ profitability throughout the launch. Preparing a recommendation for decision making, if there are signs that the objectives may not be met, including coordinating a no launch decision when necessary.
* Ensuring that launch status and launch related information are up to date in internal systems. Maintaining active oversight of all launch\-related information, ensuring data accuracy and reliability.
* Acting as the primary communicator of the launch view, proactively addressing and resolving critical issues.
* Preparing and presenting proposals for launch\-related business decisions to senior management.
* Ensuring timely and accurate reporting of launch progress and escalating issues as per internal guidance and requests.


**Primary Skills (essential)**
* 10 \+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry, with experience in the Generics sector and with at least 8 years in launch management or project management.
* Good understanding of European regulatory processes and solid experience in collaborating with finished\-product suppliers (manufacturing partners).
* Experience in leading cross\-functional teams across diverse cultural and organizational contexts.
* Ability to understand the big picture and long\-term while balancing with details and short\-term priorities.
* Strong leadership skills, with the ability to inspire, challenge, and align stakeholders toward shared goals.
* Excellent networking and communication skills.
* Proven ability to manage multiple, simultaneous launch cases/ projects with efficiency and strategic oversight.

 We’re home to more than 4,000 Orionees around the world, and we’re proud to be known as a responsible employer and a great place to work. **Company Description**
 eHealth Technologies is a leading healthcare technology company that advances the delivery of life\-altering care. Since 2006, we have decreased time to treatment for millions of patients and are trusted by the top healthcare systems, HIEs, and CROs throughout the United States.
   

  

 Our advanced technology and compassionate team expedites the collection, organization, and delivery of medical records, images, and pathology materials so that care teams have exactly what they need, where they need it, to get their patients back on the road to recovery as quickly as possible.
   

  

 Our team takes great pride in working behind the scenes for 70% of the top hospitals to help hundreds of thousands of patients every year.
   

  

**Career Opportunity Description**
 The Product Owner at eHealth Technologies operates as the CEO of the products they are assigned. They carry end\-to\-end accountability for the success of those products — not just for the delivery of features, but for the outcomes those products produce in the market, the experience customers have with them, and the commercial results they generate for the business. Where the product succeeds, the Product Owner is the person responsible; where it falls short, the Product Owner is the person who owns the gap and drives the fix.
   

  

 This role requires a whole product mindset. The software itself — the generic product — is only one component of what customers actually buy and adopt. The Product Owner is responsible for ensuring the whole product is in place: the core technology together with everything customers need to realize value from it, including documentation, training, onboarding, customer support readiness, sales enablement, implementation services, integrations, security and compliance posture, partner and vendor coordination, pricing and packaging, and the internal operational processes that surround delivery. When a gap in the whole product would undermine adoption, retention, or outcomes, the Product Owner is accountable for surfacing it and driving it to resolution — even when the work sits outside the engineering team.
   

  

 Acting as the voice of the customer and the steward of business value, this individual owns and prioritizes the product backlog, defines acceptance criteria, and drives alignment between stakeholders and development teams. In parallel, they manage sprint cadences, timelines, risks, and stakeholder communication to ensure high\-quality, on\-time delivery. They are accountable both for the right product being built and for the right conditions being in place around it for that product to succeed once delivered.
   

  

 This role is highly collaborative and customer\-facing, requiring strong communication, organization, follow\-through, and the executive judgment to make trade\-offs across competing demands. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced, team\-oriented environment, balances strategic thinking with operational rigor, and embodies a servant leadership mindset aligned with company values.

* Own and communicate a clear product vision aligned to overall product strategy, in partnership with Product Management

 You will work directly with company leadership to understand customer requirements, identify business problems, evaluate tradeoffs, propose solutions, coordinate execution across teams, and ensure that the work delivered creates meaningful business value.
 



*This is not a traditional Product Manager role and it is not a project management role.* 
 You will handle

**What You Will Do**

 • Meet customers and understand their operational and business challenges.
 



 • Distinguish between what customers ask for and the actual problem they are trying to solve.
 



 • Translate customer needs into scalable product capabilities.

 customization.
 



 • Propose solutions that balance customer value, engineering effort, scalability, and business impact.
 



 • Participate in customer discussions and help guide technical and product decisions.
 



***Product \& Business Systems***




 • Analyze cross\-functional business problems spanning multiple departments.• Design and improve business processes across product lifecycle, manufacturing, deployment,
 



 support, operations, and customer success.
 



 • Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and recurring operational issues.
 



 • Drive initiatives that improve business outcomes, reduce costs, increase scalability, or improve
 



 customer experience.
 



 • Build scalable systems and processes that help the company grow without increasing complexity.
 



***Product Strategy \& Prioritization***




 • Evaluate new product opportunities, customer requests, and strategic initiatives.
 



 • Help determine what should be built, why it should be built, and how it fits into the broader product
 



 vision.
 



 • Balance short\-term customer needs with long\-term platform and business goals.
 



 • Contribute to product roadmap discussions and strategic planning.
 



***Technical Collaboration***




 • Work closely with firmware, software, hardware, design, and operations teams.
 



 • Evaluate implementation approaches and tradeoffs.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon is seeking an International Tax Analyst to play a key role in income tax compliance and reporting for Amazon’s legal entities in EMEA.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Prepare local tax provisions for the Amazon entities under US GAAP, IFRS, Local GAAP, including preparation of current and deferred tax calculations, disclosures and journal entries for the Interim and Year End Financial Statements.
* Preparation of US GAAP tax packs for regular US GAAP Reporting.
* Preparation of EMEA Corporation Tax Returns, other tax filings and supporting work papers.
* Preparation of Advance Tax Payment calculations.
* Support the local tax payment process, including Corporation Tax.
* Support international aspects of Amazon’s worldwide provision
* Research effects of various international transactions
* Support international tax compliance and reporting aspects of mergers and acquisitions (due diligence and integration)
* Support US and international tax controversy teams on tax audits
* Assist with process improvements and automation implementation throughout the foreign tax reporting and compliance process.

  

A day in the life  

In this role you will support the EMEA International Tax Senior Manager group on the tax reporting (direct tax returns \& tax accounting) as well as on international aspects of the Amazon's worldwide income tax provision. This position will also support the US and international tax controversy teams on audits and the international planning tax team on the compliance and reporting aspects of projects (including M\&A and integration) and will work closely together with the EMEA Accounting teams.
  

  

About the team  

The Amazon tax department is a fast\-paced, team\-focused, dynamic environment. The mission of the Foreign Reporting Group is to comply with foreign local tax reporting requirements and manage the worldwide, tax\-related filings of Amazon’s foreign entities.

------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience working in a large public accounting firm or multi\-national corporate tax department
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level

* CPA

This is a high\-impact, high\-ownership role: you will define what we build, shape how we go to market, and drive the roadmap for one of the most widely used products in our database portfolio.



You will work at the intersection of customer needs, market realities, and complex technical execution — bridging engineering, infrastructure, go\-to\-market, and customer success teams to ship products customers rely on. Increasingly, databases are becoming the persistence layer for AI agents, and a first\-class participant in agentic workflows through protocols like MCP (Model Context Protocol).


**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Own and drive the product roadmap for DigitalOcean's Managed Databases (MySQL), including provisioning workflows, deployment experience, reliability, performance, and pricing — in close alignment with broader DigitalOcean objectives.
* Conduct comprehensive market analysis on database trends, competitive offerings, pricing, and emerging database technologies to inform product direction and positioning.
* Collaborate directly with Engineering and Infrastructure teams to conceptualize, develop, and deliver managed database solutions required for traditional OLTP and modern AI applications.
* Serve as the advocate for customer needs, actively collecting and prioritizing feedback to continually improve the provisioning, scaling, and day\-two operations experience.

* Use data\-driven approaches to evaluate product success, track key metrics around utilization, reliability, and deployment velocity, and guide strategic product decisions.

**What You'll Add to DigitalOcean**
-----------------------------------


* 5\+ years of product management experience specializing in cloud database products, with direct experience owning an open\-source database offering (MySQL strongly preferred).
* Deep technical knowledge of relational databases and their applications in traditional transactional workloads and modern AI/ML applications.

You have worked close enough to silicon to know what matters: accuracy, runtime, and the ability to handle complexity without falling over. When a characterization run takes six hours instead of two, you dig in and figure out why.


You are already experimenting with AI\-assisted coding tools, not because they are trendy, but because you have seen them cut debug time in half when used right. You know when to trust the output and when to rewrite it. At Synopsys, you will work on Primelib and the tools that power library creation for the most advanced process nodes in the world.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Design, develop, and own features in Primelib and related tools for standard cell library generation, characterization, and validation

* Debug complex issues across the stack, from SPICE simulation integration to data pipeline performance bottlenecks

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* You will directly improve the speed and accuracy of standard cell library creation for advanced nodes, enabling faster time\-to\-market for semiconductor products worldwide
* Your work will reduce characterization runtimes and improve tool scalability, giving design teams more iterations and better results
* You will help define how AI\-assisted development is adopted across the R\&D organization, setting patterns that other teams will follow
* The algorithms you build will process terabytes of characterization data and make library workflows more efficient at scale
* You will influence product direction by working directly with customers and field teams who depend on these tools every day
* Your mentorship will level up the engineers around you and raise the technical bar for the entire team
* The tools you ship will be used to build chips that power everything from data centers to autonomous vehicles

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field with 6\+ years of hands\-on software development experience
* Strong proficiency in C/C\+\+ for performance\-critical systems and Python for automation and scripting
* Solid grounding in data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles applied to complex, production\-grade systems
* Experience working in Linux/Unix environments with command\-line tools, build systems, and version control
* Hands\-on experience with standard cell library development, characterization flows, or related EDA tooling is a strong plus
* Familiarity with SPICE simulation, PDKs, or semiconductor design flows is a strong plus
* Demonstrated use of AI\-powered developer tools or LLMs to improve coding efficiency, debug workflows, or automate repetitive tasks is a plus

### **Who You Are**

* You can explain a complex tradeoff between runtime and accuracy to a product manager in two sentences without losing the nuance
* You have debugged a performance issue that turned out to be three layers deeper than anyone expected, and you stayed with it until it was fixed
* You are comfortable working across time zones with teams in the US, Europe, and Asia, and you know how to communicate clearly in writing when a quick call is not an option
* You push back when a feature request does not make technical sense, and you do it in a way that moves the conversation forward instead of shutting it down
* You treat code reviews as a teaching moment, not a checklist, and you leave every review better than you found it
* You are already using tools like GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar AI assistants in your workflow, and you have opinions on what works and what does not

### **Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

**Principal Product Manager** 




**Bangalore/Hyderabad/Pune (Hybrid)** 




**5\+yrs Experience; Preferably with Cybersecurity/Data Security Products** 




  





  





**What You’ll Do** 




 In this role, you will serve as the Principal Product Manager driving Teradata’s data security product management strategy and execution across our global portfolio. You will define and influence how Teradata protects the world’s most sensitive enterprise data; spanning data governance and compliance, identity and access control, AI Agent security among others.
 



 Your impact will be shaping how customers safely harness Petabyte\-scale analytics and AI through fine\-grained access controls and end\-to\-end encryption and delivering a secure and trusted environment to run their mission critical analytics. You will accelerate the delivery of Enterprise security roadmap balancing innovation with performance, governance, and compliance.
 



 Success in this role will be measured by delivering enterprise\-grade data security solutions for hybrid and multi\-cloud deployments, differentiating Teradata and unlocking measurable customer value while preserving scalability, reliability, and cost\-efficiency.
 



  





**Who you will work with** 




 On our team, we collaborate with engineering, cloud infrastructure, security operations, governance, CISO organization and UX functions to bring next\-generation data security capabilities into Teradata’s enterprise ecosystem. We are responsible for the product vision, roadmap, and execution of data security initiatives, ensuring they meet both business and technical objectives.
 



 This role reports to the Senior Director of Product Management and will partner closely with product engineering and platform leaders worldwide. You will act as the strategic data security product leader for Teradata, influencing global product direction.
 



  





**What makes you a qualified candidate** 



* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Engineering, or related field.
* 5\+ years of product management experience, including 6\+ years leading data security, data governance, or cybersecurity products at enterprise scale.
* Deep technical expertise across the data security stack, including data classification and lineage, fine\-grained access control (RBAC/ABAC, row\- and column\-level security), encryption at rest and in transit, key management (KMS, BYOK/HYOK), tokenization, and secrets management.
* Proven success embedding security and governance capabilities into enterprise data platforms, analytics, or cloud environments—ideally at petabyte scale.
* Strong technical fluency with identity and access management ecosystems and integration with enterprise IdPs.
* Hands\-on familiarity with threat detection, audit logging, anomaly detection, and data loss prevention for structured and unstructured data.
* Demonstrated knowledge of hybrid and multi\-cloud architectures and their impact on security posture, data residency, sovereignty, and cost optimization.
* Deep expertise applying compliance and regulatory frameworks and emerging AI governance standards to product design and audit readiness.
* Experience defining APIs, SDKs, policy languages, and developer integrations that make secure\-by\-default the easiest path for enterprise builders.
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to influence C\-level stakeholders—including CISOs, CDOs, and CIOs—and articulate data security product strategy to both technical and executive audiences.
* Track record of customer engagement, market analysis, and competitive benchmarking against the native security stacks of major cloud providers.



  





**What you will bring** 



* Expertise designing zero\-trust data architectures across cloud and hybrid environments, ensuring least\-privilege access without compromising analytics performance.
* Hands\-on knowledge of confidential computing, hardware\-backed key management, and emerging privacy\-enhancing technologies such as differential privacy and secure multi\-party computation.
* Ability to bridge governed, sensitive enterprise data with modern AI/ML and analytics workloads—including how to secure data used to train, fine\-tune, and serve AI models.
* A strong understanding of responsible data use—covering auditability, lineage, consent management, retention, and the handling of regulated data classes (PII, PHI, PCI).
* Vision to anticipate industry trends—quantum\-safe cryptography, AI\-driven threat detection, data sovereignty mandates—and position Teradata’s data security offerings as differentiated and enterprise\-ready.
* Passion for enabling intuitive, secure\-by\-default user experiences (e.g., natural\-language policy authoring, policy\-as\-code, automated risk insights, one\-click compliance reporting).
* Ability to operate as a senior leader—setting strategy, guiding technical direction, and influencing globally across product, engineering, GTM, and the security community.

Business Partnership \& Influence

Governance, Quality, \& Continuous Improvement

As a Senior AI/ML Technical Developer within the finance agentic platform product team, you will act as the senior technical enabler for decision science and product partners, bringing advanced AI capabilities into production. The Agentic Workspace Solution Director is the strategic leader and senior subject matter expert for Genpact's Agentic Workspace solution. You will support the vision, intellectual property, and go\-to\-market for how we help enterprise clients reimagine the modern workplace through agentic AI — building, configuring, and demonstrating solutions on Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, SharePoint, and Microsoft Foundry, while remaining fluent across the broader agentic ecosystem (Adobe, Opal (Gemini), Anthropic, and beyond).

You will partner with sales to run demos and hands\-on configuration sessions, shape multi\-platform proposals, and guide our internal teams in solutioning. Success in this role is measured by growth in Agentic Workspace pipeline and wins, the maturity and adoption of our IP, and the enablement of teams to deliver client outcomes that increase employee productivity and unlock new ways of working.
 



**Responsibilities** 




**Solution Development \& Sales Enablement** 



* **Agentic Workspace Solution Strategy:** 
 Collaborate with clients and Genpact sales teams to understand business goals, employee experience pain points, and the operating model the client wants to move toward. Define tailored Agentic Workspace solutions combining Microsoft technologies and translate technical capabilities into executive\-friendly value stories with clear linkage to productivity gains, cost takeout, and revenue enablement.
* **(Required) Microsoft Platform Mastery:** 
 Serve as Genpact's senior solution SME for the Microsoft agentic stack. Maintain deep, current expertise in Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Power Platform, and Microsoft Foundry. Maintain a deep understanding of Microsoft's agentic roadmap (new releases, private previews, partner programs) and translate that into opportunities for our clients.

 Bring credible, hands\-on experience across the broader agentic ecosystem including Adobe, OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic. Advise clients on when to lead with Microsoft, when to compose across vendors, and how to make pragmatic build/buy/compose decisions. Use this fluency to design heterogeneous agent architectures and to position Genpact as a platform\-agnostic transformation partner.

Showcase Agentic Experience suite, Spark Workspace and Spark Connect scenarios in front of client audiences.  Own the roadmap, productization, and evolution of Genpact's Agentic Experience suite. Define the offers, reference architectures, accelerators, and demo assets that make up the suite. Prioritize investment based on client demand and competitive differentiation; and ensure each component has clear value propositions, pricing, and delivery playbooks. Partner with Delivery and Engineering to harden field\-built solutions into reusable IP and retire or refactor assets as the agentic landscape evolves.

 Serve as the senior product owner for Rightpoint's Digital Workspace IP, including Spark Workspace and Spark Connect. Set the vision and feature roadmap, drive design and engineering priorities, oversee productization and packaging, and ensure tight alignment with the Microsoft platform stack and the broader Agentic Experience suite.
* **Thought Leadership:** 
 Be a recognized thought leader internally and externally for Agentic Workspace. Author whitepapers, blog posts, and whitepapers; speak at industry events, Microsoft partner forums, and client roundtables; and contribute to Genpact's brand as a leading agentic systems integrator.

Business Area: Customer Digital and Data


Area of Expertise: Data \& Analytics


Contract: Permanent


Reference Code: JR\-0000107399


  
Join us as a Data \& Record Governance Analyst at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.


To be a successful Data \& Record Governance Analyst, you should have experience with:


* This role is responsible for Data governance and Data analysis activities for Data Integration data products feature teams to build data product use cases for Loans and Savings.
* The role aims to ensure compliance with GDRMS and NFRR standard on data products.
* The role aims to develop, implement, and maintain effective governance frameworks for all data and records across the bank's global operations.
* The role demands understanding of CDEs, Data Domains, Data Products, Governance checklist, Data Quality Controls, CRA, Lineage etc.
* Data \& Record Governance, Data Glossary and MDM, Data Analysis (SQL) and Data Profiling, Data warehouse, Data Quality, Data Management and Retail Banking Domain Knowledge.

Some other highly valued skills may include:


* Python, Tableau, AWS, ER studio

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.


This role is based in Bengaluru.


**Purpose of the role**


To develop, implement, and maintain effective governance frameworks for all data and records across the bank's global operations.


**Accountabilities**


* Development and maintenance of a comprehensive data and records governance framework aligned with regulatory requirements and industry standards.
* Monitoring data quality and records metrics and compliance with standards across the organization.
* Identification and addressing of data and records management risks and gaps.
* Development and implementation of a records management programme that ensures the proper identification, classification, storage, retention, retrieval and disposal of records.
* Development and implementation of a data governance strategy that aligns with the bank's overall data management strategy and business objectives.
* Provision of Group wide guidance and training on Data and Records Management standard requirements.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**


* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.

Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes

They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.

They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Job Title: Analyst \- Data Scientist
Grade : C3


### **Shift: 2 pm to 11 pm IST**


### **Role: Individual contributor role.**

**Introduction to role:**
-------------------------


Are you ready to dive into the world of commercial analytics and make a real impact? As a Data Scientist, you'll partner with cross\-functional teams to tackle business challenges head\-on using data\-driven solutions. Your mission will be to build, develop, and deploy advanced AI and machine learning models. You will use diverse healthcare datasets to uncover actionable insights and optimize business processes.


**Accountabilities:**
---------------------


Platform \& Pipeline Ownership: Design, build, and maintain robust ETL/ELT pipelines across Snowflake, Redshift, S3, and AWS services; implement workflow orchestration with Apache Airflow and similar tools; manage environments for reliability, observability, and cost efficiency.


Data Integration \& Quality: Ingest and harmonize internal and external data, including EHR, administrative claims, and laboratory data (e.g., IQVIA, Komodo, Symphony, Prognos); implement data profiling, quality checks, reconciliation, and lineage to ensure accuracy and timeliness.


Data Modeling \& Performance: Engineer curated data models and feature\-ready datasets and marts; optimize SQL and storage strategies; enable performant data services that power analytics dashboards and ML scoring.


Automation \& DevOps: Apply scheduling, monitoring, alerting, and process improvements. Use Git\-based CI/CD methods. Build reusable components and frameworks that coordinate and prioritize data descriptions to streamline transformations and business rules at scale.


Architecture, Security \& Governance: Contribute to cloud architecture decisions, data cataloging, access controls, and governance standards; promote best practices for scalability, security, and compliance in healthcare/biopharma contexts.


BAU \& Support: Provide operational support for data solutions, manage tickets and incident response, and drive continuous improvement across pipelines and platform processes.


**Essential Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------


* Education \& Experience: BS/MS in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Economics) and at least 4\+ years of relevant data engineering/analytics engineering experience.
* AI\-Native Data Science Orientation: Strong inclination toward AI\-first problem solving, with an understanding of modern AI paradigms including Generative AI and Agentic AI systems. Ability to design data systems that support intelligent, autonomous decision\-making workflows.
* Core Technologies: Proficiency with Python and SQL; hands\-on experience with Snowflake, AWS (e.g., S3, Lambda), Amazon Redshift, Apache Spark, and Apache Airflow. Familiarity with MongoDB, Oracle, Teradata, and/or SQL Server.
* Data Engineering Skills: Strong track record building ETL/ELT pipelines, integrating diverse sources, orchestrating workflows, and implementing data quality, lineage, and governance. Proven performance tuning and scalability practices.
* Statistical \& Analytical Expertise: Solid grounding in statistics, experimental design, and advanced analytics, with the ability to translate business problems into data science solutions and validate outputs rigorously.
* Healthcare Data Expertise: Hands\-on experience working with EMR/EHR, claims, laboratory, and epidemiological datasets, with a strong understanding of healthcare data models, standards, and challenges.
* Analytics \& DS Fundamentals: Ability to translate business logic into technical requirements and analytical datasets; experience supporting feature engineering and model operations; proficiency in data manipulation, cleansing, and interpretation; ability to analyze results and present findings.
* Business \& Domain Context: Ability to bridge data science, epidemiology, and business context, ensuring solutions are impactful and aligned with commercial and healthcare objectives.
* Communication \& Collaboration: Clear written and verbal communication to convey complex methods and outcomes to technical and non\-technical stakeholders; comfortable working cross\-functionally and in cross\-cultural environments.
* Operational Excellence: Experience with support/maintenance projects, ticket handling, and change management; experience with Git and CI/CD workflows.

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------


* Agentic AI \& Advanced AI Systems: Experience designing or working with Agentic AI frameworks, multi\-agent systems, or autonomous decision pipelines, including orchestration of AI agents for complex problem\-solving.
* Model Enablement: Partner with Commercial Data Science and Advanced Analytics teams to translate business logic into technical requirements; prepare analytical datasets and features; optimize queries and data flows for model training, scoring, and monitoring.
* Applied Analytics: Conduct analyses using HCP and de\-identified patient\-level healthcare data to generate disease insights, lead generation, targeting, segmentation, and field alerts; maintain scalable analytical assets for recurring use cases.
* Methods \& Tools: Contribute to predictive modeling workflows (e.g., regression, classification, clustering, time series); support development and optimization of ML tools that improve patient finding and HCP identification; build dashboards and reports in Tableau, Power BI, Qlik, or Databricks/Dataiku notebooks.
* Collaboration: Work with Commercial partners and the internal AI community to identify value\-driving opportunities and share best practices; support ad hoc analyses and production operations as needed.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Meet the Team:**  

We are a high\-performing Data and Analytics team dedicated to delivering insights and analytics for GTM Sales Use cases. Our mission is to drive the growth of Cisco’s Sales and recurring business and embed AI into every layer of decision\-making. By demonstrating machine learning, large language models (LLMs), and automation, we are redefining how data fuels innovation and efficiency at scale.
  
  

**Your Impact:**  

As a Data Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in transforming insights and analytics for Sales, Customer Success, and Renewals. You will analyze large datasets from platforms such as Snowflake, and EDW Terradata to uncover trends, find opportunities, and drive strategic decision\-making. By developing and maintaining dashboards, generating real\-time reports, and creating actionable visualizations, you will empower business teams with critical metrics and insights. Your expertise in data interpretation, reporting tools, and business intelligence will enable you to translate complex data into meaningful stories that support Cisco’s data\-driven culture, foster innovation, and enhance performance across Sales and Renewals.
  
  

To be successful in this role, you exemplify our culture and embrace our principles. As a Data Analyst, you will:
  
  

* Analyze and interpret large volumes of structured and unstructured data to uncover actionable insights for Sales, Customer Success, and Renewals.
* Develop, maintain, and optimize reports and dashboards by integrating data from diverse sources, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of key business metrics.
* Apply data validation and quality checks to maintain data integrity and reliability across all analytics outputs.
* Collaborate with business and technical teams to design data models and schemas that support both analytical and operational needs.
* Evaluate and recommend data storage solutions, including relational databases, NoSQL databases, data lakes, and cloud storage services, to best support business intelligence initiatives.
* Optimize data retrieval and visualization processes to ensure scalability and performance for end users.
* Stay ahead of with industry trends and best practices in analytics, business intelligence, and data visualization to continually enhance the value of insights provided to the organization.


Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, with 4\-8 years of relevant experience
* Demonstrated experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or related analytical roles, with a minimum of 4 years focused on interpreting and visualizing data/reporting.
* Proficiency in SQL (Snowflake, SAP HANA) and experience with data querying, reporting, and visualization tools.
* Good understanding of database systems, data modeling techniques, and best practices in data management.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms and services (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform).


Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Knowledge of Sales, Renewals data and the ability to generate actionable business insights from these domains.
* Experience working with large datasets and modern analytics frameworks.
* Exposure to AI/ML concepts, including large language models (LLMs), transformer architectures, and advanced analytics platforms.
* Advanced degree or equivalent experience in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* Understanding of vector databases, semantic search, and retrieval\-augmented analytics techniques.
* Familiarity with responsible AI practices, data governance, and enterprise data ethics frameworks.
* Experience with advanced analytics tools such as Snowflake Cortex, and exposure to MLOps or workflow automation platforms is a plus.


Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.description:
**Overview:**


We are looking for an experienced, Senior Business Analyst to join our Capital Markets and Managed Services product organisation to support Report Hub. You will play a central role in shaping, documenting, and validating business requirements, acting as the bridge between product leadership, and engineering teams to ensure successful delivery of change.


This role sits within the product team and reports on a day\-to\-day basis to one of our Product Owners. You will work closely with developers, and internal product stakeholders to translate business needs into clear, actionable specifications and ensure solutions are delivered in line with expectations.

**The Role**


The ideal candidate combines **strong business analysis fundamentals with enough technical fluency** **to engage confidently in solution discussions**. You will be comfortable working in an agile delivery environment, writing high\-quality Jira tickets with acceptance criteria, supporting technical refinement, and following requirements through the full delivery lifecycle from initial definition to testing and client handover.

**Key responsibilities include:**

* **Requirements Definition**: Elicit, analyse, and document business requirements for client\-driven initiatives, ensuring clarity, completeness, and alignment with business objectives.
* **Specification Ownership**: Create and maintain detailed business specifications in Jira, including well\-structured user stories, business context, and clear acceptance criteria for development teams.
* **Client Engagement**: Act as a client\-facing representative for requirements gathering and clarification, building strong working relationships and ensuring expectations are managed effectively throughout delivery.
* **Delivery Support**: Follow development work through implementation, provide ongoing clarification to engineering teams, and answer questions that arise during technical refinement and delivery.
* **Testing \& Validation**: Execute functional testing in our internal testing system to validate delivered solutions against agreed requirements prior to handover to the client.
* **Process Modelling**: Support the analysis and documentation of business processes and workflows where needed to help clarify current and target state operating models.

 **Required Skills \& Experience**

* **Data \& Integration Awareness:** Familiarity with relational database concepts, REST APIs, and JSON data structures sufficient to understand system behaviour, integrations, and data flows.
* **User Interface Understanding:** Ability to analyse and define user\-facing functionality with an appreciation for usability, workflow, and interface behaviour.
* **Process Analysis:** Working knowledge of business process modelling concepts and experience documenting workflows, process steps, and interactions across systems and teams.
* **Testing Discipline:** Experience executing functional or business validation testing to confirm delivered solutions meet agreed requirements.

**Professional Experience**

* **Business Analysis Background:** Minimum 5 years of experience in a Business Analyst role within a software, product, or change delivery environment.
* **Client\-facing Experience:** Proven experience working directly with clients to gather requirements, manage expectations, and secure sign\-off on functional scope.
* **Regulatory Reporting Experience:** Experience working with regulatory reporting in financial services, particularly derivatives and securities. (ESMA; FCA; SFTR; MAS; ASIC; MiFIR; KRX; HKMA; BOI; SEC; CFTC; Canada)
* **Agile Delivery Exposure:** Experience working with product and engineering teams in an agile environment, supporting requirements through refinement, build, testing, and release.
* **End\-to\-end Ownership:** Demonstrated ability to take ownership of requirements from initial definition through to testing and final handover.

**Soft Skills**

* **Communication:** Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate between business and technical audiences.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Confident and professional in dealing with client stakeholders and internal teams across multiple levels of seniority.
* **Organisation:** Able to manage multiple workstreams, prioritise effectively, and maintain a high level of attention to detail.
* **Ownership Mindset:** Proactive, accountable, and comfortable working independently while remaining closely aligned with the wider product team.
* **Analytical Thinking:** Structured and methodical approach to analysing requirements, identifying gaps, and resolving ambiguity.

**Nice to Have**

* Familiarity with front\-to\-back workflows in capital markets or issuance\-related platforms.
* Exposure to internal UAT, client acceptance processes, or pre\-release validation activities.
